function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] NEVER use this param when use reply code block.

type.description: python: run .py code ONLY (never shell commands); bash: shell commands like ls/mkdir/grep/git (mac/linux); powershell: windows

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JS. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. No guessing. Act accurately to reduce web_scan calls. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, prefer to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers. Multiple questions should in one call

question.description: For multiple questions, one per line (contain candidates)

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for a single question only. Leave empty for multi-questions

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed

function.name: code_search
function.description: Search code content by regex pattern using ripgrep. Returns matched lines with file:line:content. Much faster and more token-efficient than code_run grep/rg.

path.description: Directory or file to search in. Defaults to cwd

include.description: Glob to include files, e.g. '*.py', '*.{js,ts}'. Comma-separated for multiple

exclude.description: Glob to exclude, e.g. 'node_modules', '*.min.js'. Comma-separated for multiple

file_pattern.description: Only search files whose NAME matches this glob (e.g. '*config*')

max_results.description: Max matched lines to return (default 50, max 200)

fixed_strings.description: Treat pattern as literal string, not regex

function.name: file_find
function.description: Find files by name pattern using ripgrep --files. Returns matching file paths. Respects .gitignore.

path.description: Root directory to search. Defaults to cwd

sort_by.description: Sort by path (default) or modification time (newest first)

function.name: git_checkpoint
function.description:
Structured Git workflow (replaces raw `code_run` git commands). One tool, 9 actions:
• status: branch + staged/unstaged/untracked (porcelain-v2 parsed)
• diff: file diff with stat (staged or working tree)
• commit: add + commit (blocked on main/master)
• checkpoint: commit + tag with ga-ckpt-<ts>-<shortsha> for one-click restore
• list: enumerate ga-ckpt-* tags with files-changed count
• restore: git reset --hard to a checkpoint (requires no_confirm=true; logs to .workbuddy/git_restore.log; reflog retains prior HEAD for undo)
• branch: list / create / switch (use this before commit)
• log: --oneline --graph log
• pr: push current branch to remote (myfork>origin), then create PR. Tries `gh pr create` first, falls back to GitHub REST API using mykey.github_token / $GITHUB_TOKEN.
Use this instead of code_run for any git operation; it's atomic, recoverable, and gives structured output. cwd defaults to self.cwd (searches up to 8 levels for .git).

cwd.description: Repo root override. Default: search up from self.cwd

message.description: Commit / checkpoint message (required for commit, checkpoint)

files.description: Specific files to add. Default for commit/checkpoint: all changes (add_all=true)

all.description: Add all changes (incl. untracked). Default true for commit/checkpoint

staged.description: For diff: show staged diff instead of working tree. Default false

checkpoint_id.description: For restore: checkpoint id (ga-ckpt-... or short sha). Required.

branch.description: For branch action: name to create/switch. Omit to list branches.

create_from.description: For branch create: base ref. Default HEAD.

max_count.description: For list / log: max entries. Default 20 / 15.

pr_target.description: For pr: target branch. Default: origin/HEAD or main.

remote.description: For pr: preferred remote. Default: myfork > origin.

no_confirm.description: Skip safety confirmation for restore. Default false.

function.name: repo_index
function.description: Preloaded structural repo index (Codex-style): scans the repo via ripgrep into a file inventory + symbol map + language stats, cached in .ga_search/repo_index.json. Build once at session start on a large repo, then query files/symbols instantly via find/symbols instead of walking the tree with code_run.

action.description: build: create/reuse index; rebuild: force rebuild; stats: overview; find: locate files by name substring; symbols: locate symbol definitions

query.description: Query for find/symbols (filename substring or symbol name)

path.description: Repo root to index. Defaults to cwd

force.description: Force rebuild the index on build

function.name: semantic_search
function.description: Semantic / natural-language code search (Cursor-style). If an embedding backend is configured in mykey (embedding_apikey or reusing native_oai_*), chunks source files, vectorizes them, and retrieves by cosine similarity. Otherwise auto-falls back to 'smart ripgrep': extracts keywords + synonym expansion from the query and runs regex search. Use for intent-based queries like 'where is user login/auth handled'.

query.description: Natural-language description of the code you want, e.g. 'function that handles user login authentication'

path.description: Repo root to search. Defaults to cwd

force.description: Force rebuild the vector index when an embedding backend is present
